source: Kawasaki Ultra LX Service Manual, Fuel System (DFI) 3-22/3-23 Service Code Table; ECU pins from 3-18 Terminal Names
note: Codes are the ECU's numeric service codes. 'meter' is what the dash shows in dealer mode. Past codes are stored in the ECU and readable/erasable only via KDS.

codes.title: Throttle sensor
codes.problem: Throttle sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Throttle sensor connector unplugged or corroded
Broken/shorted wire between sensor and ECU
Loss of 5 V sensor supply or sensor ground (shared with other sensors)
codes.failSafe: Ignition timing locked to closed-throttle timing; fueling switches to D-J (pressure/RPM) method.

codes.title: Inlet air pressure (MAP) sensor
codes.problem: Inlet air pressure sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: MAP sensor connector unplugged or corroded
Vacuum hose off, cracked or blocked
Loss of 5 V sensor supply or sensor ground

codes.title: Inlet air temperature sensor
codes.problem: Inlet air temperature sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: IAT sensor connector unplugged or corroded

codes.title: Water temperature sensor
codes.problem: Water temperature sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Water temp sensor connector unplugged or corroded

codes.title: Crankshaft sensor
codes.problem: Crankshaft sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Sensor air gap or damaged/dirty pickup
Failed sensor (check resistance and peak voltage)
codes.failSafe: None listed (engine will not run without crank signal).

codes.title: Camshaft position sensor
codes.problem: Camshaft position sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Cam timing off after engine work
codes.failSafe: Continues firing in the same sequence as the last good signal.

codes.title: Vehicle-down sensor
codes.problem: Vehicle-down sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Sensor mounted incorrectly or ski on its side
codes.failSafe: Limits engine below 3000 rpm by cutting ignition.

codes.title: Key collation error
causes: Key not registered to this ECU
Interference from another key or metal near the key

codes.title: Fuel pump relay (open)
codes.problem: Fuel pump relay malfunction, wiring open
causes: Open relay coil or broken control wire

codes.title: Fuel pump relay (stuck)
codes.problem: Fuel pump relay malfunction, relay is stuck

codes.title: Ignition coil #1/#4
codes.problem: Ignition coil #1, #4 malfunction, wiring open or short
codes.failSafe: Injectors #1/#4 shut off (cylinders 1 and 4 get no fuel).

codes.title: Ignition coil #2/#3
codes.problem: Ignition coil #2, #3 malfunction, wiring open or short
codes.failSafe: Injectors #2/#3 shut off (cylinders 2 and 3 get no fuel).

codes.title: Engine overheat
causes: Clogged cooling water inlet or pickup (weeds, sand)
Running out of water too long
Water temp sensor reading falsely high
codes.failSafe: Limits engine below 3000 rpm by cutting ignition.

codes.title: Engine oil pressure low
causes: Oil pressure switch connector unplugged or wire shorted to ground
codes.failSafe: Limits engine below 3000 rpm by cutting ignition.

codes.title: Oil temperature sensor
codes.problem: Oil temperature sensor malfunction, wiring open or short
causes: Oil temp sensor connector unplugged or corroded
codes.failSafe: ECU assumes 60 °C oil and limits engine below 3000 rpm.

codes.title: Main (ECU) relay / system relay
codes.problem: Main (ECU) relay and system relay malfunction, wiring open or relay stuck

codes.title: Engine oil overheat
causes: Oil temp sensor reading falsely high
codes.failSafe: Limits engine below 3000 rpm by cutting ignition.
